target: Arquitectura funcional para el centro/micro-salas internas de Brumak; referencia visual del contexto zone.brumak.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / BUILT ENVIRONMENT — NO CREATURE. Zona exterior de Brumak adaptada con el tiempo para visitantes de mayor tamaño. Debe revelar el contraste entre un patio relativamente amplio y la arquitectura Dravak extremadamente compacta que lo rodea: pequeños accesos, pasajes, talleres y niveles aprovechando grietas y paredes naturales. No subterráneo, no fortaleza enana.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / BUILT ENVIRONMENT — NO CREATURE. Create a wide architectural environment view of a canonical visitor reception courtyard inside Brumak in the Pedrales de Korven. The courtyard is modestly wider than the settlement's interior passages because trade with larger visitors forced repeated expansions. Around it, compact Dravak architecture uses existing rock walls, shallow cavities, narrow gaps and multiple small levels with almost no wasted space. Show low adult-scale Dravak doorways, tight covered passages, tiny work patios, shelves and roof supports fitted between natural stone masses. The courtyard itself shows visible layers of enlargement and repair rather than one grand design. Keep open sky visible: Brumak is NOT an underground city. Dry fractured rock protects the settlement from wind. Architecture feels ingenious, dense, practical and mature, built for adult bodies roughly 65–75% human height.
negative_constraints: Do not depict a dwarf fortress, mine city, underground hall or monumental stone citadel
No giant gates, throne halls, statues or fantasy forge spectacle
Keep open sky visible and use surface rock formations
Architecture must read smaller and denser than human scale without looking child-sized
No lava, glowing runes, crystals, magic or steampunk machinery
No invented heraldry or readable signage
CATEGORY LOCK: architecture/built environment is the focal subject; no creature, animal or monster may replace it.

CANON HARD FAIL: reject modern backpacks, modern clothing/technology, generic contemporary visitors, or inhabitants/species that contradict the architecture brief. Built scale, doors, circulation and furniture must visibly support the canonical inhabitants named in this request.
notes: Representa la zona históricamente adaptada para visitantes; no convierte Brumak en ciudad subterránea ni fortaleza clásica. Regeneration batch 2026-10-01: previous draft deleted by art direction; regenerate from this hardened request and do not use the deleted draft as visual reference.
